title: Locally rough seas creating hazardous conditions for small craft operators and sea bathers.
summary: Seas 6 to 8 feet (1.8 to 2.4 meters). Brisk winds and moderate to high northeasterly/easterly swells.

•	Small Craft: Increased risk of capsizing or taking on water. Open boats and smaller vessels will face significant chopping and vertical rolling.
•	Sea Bathers: Dangerous breaking waves at the coast and strong, unpredictable rip currents.
Recommended Actions
•	Small Craft Operators: Exercise high caution. Secure vessels properly, monitor conditions closely, and avoid operating in open waters if inexperienced.
•	Sea Bathers & Swimmers: Exercise extreme caution. title: Advisory: Mild-to-moderate haze visible
summary: A plume of mild-to-moderate Saharan dust is approaching the island. Horizontal visibility is observed to be between 6 km and 9 km. Particulate matter levels (PM2.5) are forecasted to range between 25 and 50 micrograms per cubic meter, resulting in Moderate Air Quality (AQI 51–100)

title: A Low Level Trough System Expected To Bring Heavy Rainfall to St. Lucia.
summary: Heavy rainfall is expected due to the passage of a low level trough system as well as an approaching tropical wave. Frequent heavy rain may result in flash flooding especially in the Dennery area and areas Nearby.  Motorways will be impacted with water levels rising rapidly as well as fallen rocks  affecting driving conditions. Visibility will also be affected.

title: Extremely Active Tropical Wave to Bring Heavy Rainfall to St. Lucia
summary:
An extremely active tropical wave is expected to bring frequent heavy rain, with active thunderstorms and gusty winds to Saint Lucia tonight. 
There is a moderate risk of rainfall intensities between 25 to 40 mm/h in localized downpours.
Rainfall of this intensity can cause surface and/or flash flooding, especially in areas such as Bexon, Soufriere, and Castries Town and their vicinity and other low-lying areas such as streams, rivers or narrow valleys, and may also lead to slips in the vicinity. Strong winds and lightning can affect the electricity grid. 

Impact:
Ponds, streams and canals may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, rock fall, landslips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Commute times will be longer. Electricity power outage possible.
